title: Foundation Marketing Helped Strengthen Bitly's Position as a Top-Cited Brand in AI Search Through an Integrated GEO Program
ai_summary: Foundation Marketing joined Profound's inaugural agency certification cohort, citing Bitly's success in AI search. Bitly now holds 11.7% citation share among link shorteners, nearly double the next competitor, and saw a 422% increase in Reddit referral sessions. Foundation now offers Profound-powered baseline audits to all clients.

title: 'Instinct becomes the backup plan instead of the default': How marketers can beat data overload to make better decisions
ai_summary: In an interview with Bitly CMO Tara Robertson, the author discusses how data overload has pushed marketers back toward gut-based decisions, with 56% relying on instinct. Findings show teams average six measurement tools, 86% wait until campaigns end to analyze data, and only 14% track micro-interactions. Robertson recommends granular interaction analysis, AI-assisted insights, and flexible budgets.
